# Rufus Vane

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-30s to early 40s (estimated)  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v2 c6 P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 c11 P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased (died of yellow fever in Cuba 13 years prior)  <sub>[v4 c9 P9](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0009), [v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls (or surrounding area), St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v2 c6 P14](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0014), [v2 c6 P15](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0015), [v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Small mill operator / farmer / sailor / store clerk  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

In his youth, Rufus was a tall, good-looking man with a red face and a nautical inclination. He had a unique physical feature shared with his cousin Laurence: one hazel eye and one blue eye.

_Sources: [v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028), [v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033)_

## Personality

In his youth, Rufus possessed a small, wicked soul and a selfish, unstable nature. He pursued things passionately until he obtained them, only to quickly lose interest and seek new distractions. He drank heavily, engaged in wild brawls, and held no regard for the feelings or well-being of others.

_Sources: [v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028), [v2 c6 P29](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0029), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033)_

## Traits

- Selfish  <sub>[v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028)</sub>
- Inconstant  <sub>[v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028)</sub>
- Heavy drinker  <sub>[v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033)</sub>
- Ruthless  <sub>[v2 c6 P29](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0029)</sub>

## Abilities

- Seafaring and sailing  <sub>[v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Lorna Ainslie by coercing her family  <sub>[v2 c6 P29](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0029)</sub>

## History

Rufus Vane grew up in Seven Gulls, the son of storekeeper Abner Vane. As a young man, he became infatuated with Lorna Ainslie, but she repeatedly rejected him. Taking advantage of his father holding the mortgage on the Ainslie farm, Rufus threatened to foreclose unless Lorna agreed to marry him, forcing her into a loveless marriage at age sixteen. A year later, after her mother passed away, Rufus grew tired of domestic life and sailed away aboard the Four Sisters to Cuba. While in Havana, he contracted yellow fever and died, leaving behind his cousin Laurence Vane, who nursed him until his death. Shortly after, Laurence suffered a severe head injury that erased his memory, leading him to be mistaken for Rufus and brought back to Seven Gulls, where he lived as Lorna's invalid husband for eleven years before an operation restored his memory and revealed Rufus's true fate.

_Sources: [v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028), [v2 c6 P29](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0029), [v4 c9 P9](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0009), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Son of Abner Vane of Seven Gulls  <sub>[v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028), [v2 c6 P29](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0029)</sub>
- Double cousin of Laurence Vane from Nova Scotia  <sub>[v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Coerced Lorna Ainslie into marrying him by threatening to foreclose on her family's farm  <sub>[v2 c6 P29](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0029)</sub>
